name: Zum Lamm
kurzbeschreibung: Family-run Hotel-Restaurant Zum Lamm in Tarrenz near Imst: Tyrolean and international cuisine, a starting point for hikers, bikers and coach tours.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Hotel-Restaurant Zum Lamm is located at Hauptstraße 5 in Tarrenz (postal code 6464) in the Tyrolean Gurgltal valley, just a few kilometres from the district capital Imst. The family-run house in Tyrolean style is run as a comfortable three-star hotel and combines accommodation and gastronomy under one roof. Situated in the Imst-Gurgltal holiday region, it is a popular port of call for holidaymakers and travellers passing through alike. The hotel's own restaurant serves Tyrolean and international cuisine; hotel guests and day visitors sit in the dining room, in the parlours or, in fine weather, on the terrace with a view of the Alps. The offering includes a rich breakfast buffet as well as half board with a four-course dinner. A hotel bar and a cellar bar round off the stay.

History/Background

The house looks back on a long tradition as an inn on the Fernpass route. Over the years it has established itself in the Imst-Gurgltal holiday region as a coach tour and motorcycle hotel. The host is named as Ralf Rauchberger, who positions the house as a biker hotel. From winter 2026, Hotel Zum Lamm will be continued by the new operator keyone as „keyone rooms Tarrenz“; bookings and enquiries have since been handled by the new operating company.

Getting there

By car, the house can be reached via the Inntal motorway A12 (Imst-Pitztal exit) and via the Fernpass road B179; following the signs towards Tarrenz, the property lies centrally on the main road. A free parking space is available directly at the house. For train travellers, Imst-Pitztal station is the nearest arrival point; buses run from there. The nearest stop „Tarrenz Gemeindeamt“ is only about 100 metres away; from here buses run to Nassereith and to Imst bus station. Innsbruck can be reached by car in around 42 minutes.

Tips

Motorcyclists value the house as a starting point for tours near the Hahntennjoch and the Fernpass; a shelter, garage and drying room are available. Hikers, cyclists and climbers will find a dense network of trails and numerous alpine pastures and huts in the surrounding area. For relaxation, a wellness area with sauna, steam bath and infrared cabin is available. Pets are welcome for an extra charge. Guests also benefit from the ImstCard with discounts on mountain railways, tours and buses in the Imst outdoor region.

Best time to travel

Tarrenz and the Gurgltal can be visited all year round. The warmer months are suitable for hiking, cycling and motorcycle tours when the Hahntennjoch and Fernpass are passable. In winter, the region is within reach of several ski areas of the Tyrolean Oberland; for winter sports enthusiasts, a ski room and a ski boot warmer are available at the house. Those seeking peace and the mountain landscape away from the high season choose spring or autumn.
